items.title: Abbie Williams Interview, 1966-06-02
items.q: I remember playing with him in between time... Paul Barnes was in the army. And I built this school... And who did you use in the band? ... Paul Barnes, and Trumpet was Eulie Young.

ctx.x: Had you been playing with him long before you went on that wagon or you just started with him?
No, no. I remember playing with him in between time because I got a book here. Paul Barnes was in the army. And I built this school. You might get some of it out of here.
